title: Output phản hồi input không escape (comment) / Reflected XSS in comments
expected: Script xuất hiện và có thể trigger alert trong DOM
remediation: Escape output server-side; Content-Security-Policy; input validation / Escape output, CSP

title: Form login trả lỗi khi thử ' OR '1'='1 / Authentication bypass / SQL error
expected: Bypass login or SQL error visible
remediation: Use prepared statements / parameterized queries / ORM
notes: Use read-only tests; avoid destructive payloads.

title: Tham số file có thể truy cập đường dẫn tương đối ../../.. / Local File Inclusion
category: A06:2023 – Vulnerable and Outdated Components / Broken Access? (contextual)
steps: Truy cập URL with file param
expected: Nội dung file (hoặc phần) xuất hiện trong response
remediation: Whitelist paths, canonicalize, deny .. / path traversal protection

title: Form thay đổi state không có CSRF token / CSRF on state-changing form
payloads: Craft HTML form auto-submit to target action
expected: State changed without user token validation
remediation: CSRF tokens, SameSite cookies, require authentication confirmation

title: Session ID predictable / Broken authentication (session)
remediation: Use secure random session IDs, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite

title: Sensitive data (credit card) stored/transmitted plaintext / Sensitive Data Exposure
remediation: Encrypt at rest, TLS, avoid logging PII

title: Tham số id có thể truy xuất dữ liệu người khác / Insecure Direct Object Reference
remediation: Enforce authorization checks server-side, use indirect references

title: URL fetch parameter cho phép request nội bộ / Server-Side Request Forgery
expected: Server returns internal resource or times out indicating fetch
remediation: Validate/whitelist target hosts; block internal ranges

title: Directory listing bật / Security misconfiguration (directory index)
remediation: Disable directory listing; proper access controls

title: Insecure deserialization → controllable object leads to behavior change / Insecure Deserialization
category: A08:2023 – Software and Data Integrity Failures
expected: App executes unintended action or throws specific error
remediation: Avoid native deserialization; use safe formats and integrity checks (signing)

title: XML upload parses external entity → file disclosure / XML External Entity
remediation: Disable external entities, use secure XML parsers

title: No rate limiting on auth endpoints → brute-force possible / Rate limit missing
category: A09:2023 – Security Logging and Monitoring Failures? (auth)

title: API returns excessive user data in response / Excessive data exposure
remediation: Apply least privilege, filter fields server-side

title: Missing Content-Security-Policy on pages with inline scripts / Missing CSP
expected: No CSP or overly permissive CSP

title: Application logs contain secrets (API keys/passwords) / Sensitive logging
payloads: Submit input containing SECRET_TEST=12345 → check logs
remediation: Sanitize logs, mask secrets, avoid logging PII/credentials
